metadata.name: RF-CL (Risk Factor-Weighted Clinical Likelihood of Obstructive CAD)
metadata.summary: Estimates the pre-test clinical likelihood (%) of obstructive coronary artery disease in patients with stable chest pain or dyspnoea (2024 ESC CCS Guidelines Figure 4).
clinical_pearls: Score EITHER chest pain characteristics (0–3) OR exertional dyspnoea (2 points), not both simultaneously.
<=5% Very Low likelihood identifies patients in whom routine further diagnostic testing may be deferred.
Endorsed as the first-line pre-test probability model in the 2024 ESC Chronic Coronary Syndromes Guidelines, reducing overestimation seen with legacy Diamond-Forrester models.

Pitfall — Intermediate risk refinement & exclusions: Patients with >5%–15% or moderate clinical likelihood often benefit from adding Coronary Artery Calcium Scoring (CACS-CL) or functional imaging; not applicable to acute coronary syndromes.

items.label: Symptom Score (Chest Pain Features 0–3, or Dyspnoea = 2)
items.subtitle: 1 pt each: (1) constricting retrosternal/neck/jaw/arm discomfort, (2) provoked by exertion/emotion, (3) relieved by rest/nitrates <=5 min.

options.label: 2 points (2 chest pain features OR exertional dyspnoea)

items.label: RF 1: Family History of Premature CAD (1st-degree: M <55y, F <65y)

interpretation.label: Very Low Likelihood (<=5%)
interpretation.summary: Deferring further diagnostic testing is recommended unless compelling clinical modifiers exist.

interpretation.label: Low Likelihood (>5% to 15%)
interpretation.summary: Consider CACS-CL reclassification or non-invasive testing if clinically indicated.

interpretation.label: Moderate Likelihood (>15% to 50%)
interpretation.summary: Non-invasive anatomical (CCTA) or functional imaging recommended.

interpretation.label: High Likelihood (>50%)
interpretation.summary: Functional imaging or invasive coronary angiography strongly recommended.
